title: Чужая чашка у бара  (Someone Else's Mug at the Bar)

segments.t: While Senya and Fedya continue their loud feud over Maxim Galkin in the kitchen, a new conflict breaks out at the bar counter. Exhausted after a restless night, Sasha casually drinks coffee out of Nastya's personal mug, leaving Kostya caught in the middle.
Не могу проснуться, всю ночь плохо спала.
В смысле у меня и у тебя.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'Come on, say that one more time.' In Russian, the idea of 'come on' flows naturally into 'time' without extra filler words.
'Do you even know who your Galkin is?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'this' before landing on 'who'.
'Who? Got it?' Lyova brings out the contrast between 'who' and 'understood?' in a few short words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Kostya, please pass me my coffee.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Kostya' and finishing on 'coffee'.
Не могу проснуться, всю ночь плохо спала.
'I cannot wake up, I slept terribly all night.' Notice how Russian expresses 'not' and 'slept' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Thank you very much.' The meaning hinges on 'thank you' working together with 'big' in spoken Russian. Chef Viktor answers right away.
В смысле у меня и у тебя.
'What do you mean, mine and yours.' Notice how Russian expresses 'sense' and 'you' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'What do you mean, I took it?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'sense' before landing on 'him'.
'We will figure something out.' In Russian, the idea of 'something' flows naturally into 'to think up' without extra filler words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'There is Galkin for you.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'there you go' before landing on 'Galkin'.
'While in Russia everything is the other way around.' The grammar packs 'and' and 'contrary' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'What? Really?' Lyova raises the pitch on 'yes' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'And what about this!' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'there you go' in a few short words. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Не могу проснуться, всю ночь плохо спала.
В смысле у меня и у тебя.
When you watch Scene 5 of Episode 11, listen out for the exchange around someone else's mug at the bar — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
